# Vendored libraries

These browser-ready bundles are vendored locally (no CDN, per the widget CSP)
and are unmodified upstream builds:

- `pdf-lib.min.js` — [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) 1.17.1, MIT
- `docx.iife.js` — [docx](https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx) 9.7.1, MIT (`dist/index.iife.js`)
- `pptxgen.bundle.js` — [PptxGenJS](https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS) 4.0.1, MIT
- `xlsx.full.min.js` — [SheetJS](https://sheetjs.com/) (xlsx) 0.18.5, Apache-2.0
